derivation:
by
  by_cases h : f = 0; · simp [h]
  simpa [Place.ord, neg_nonneg, WithZero.log_le_iff_le_exp (show v.adicValuation f ≠ 0 by simpa using h)] using v.heightOneSpectrum.valuation_le_one (K := F) (⟨f, hf⟩ : v.toValuationSubring)
explanation: Instantiate the declaration with the valuation subring, its maximal height-one prime, and fraction field F. Its valuation bound translates to nonnegativity of the negative logarithm defining ord; zero is handled by simp.
